description: Precedence 503 > 413: while closing, a /mcp request whose body exceeds the cap gets 503 {"error":"service closing"}; the body is never read, because a body that will be refused is not read. MCPWARP.md §4 precedence table (I2)
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 95

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search","arguments":{"q":"x"}}}
out:
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 27

{"error":"service closing"}
notes: In state disabled the body is "service disabled" and the precedence is the same.
